result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the main LOC of the repositories with commits in the past 90 days. Before, its LOC text used the 180-day figure.

The fix is one word in `addBigRepositoriesSummary` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportOverviewSection.java`: the block's LOC text now uses `loc90Days` instead of `loc180Days`. The percentage already used the 90-day figure, so the block is now consistent.

The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or add one for your 500 LOC / 2,000 LOC example.
